body.question: Decision 0001 says shared links never expire. Does this change replace it, or add a choice beside it?

options.answer: Add a choice; links with no time never expire
options.rationale: Keeps decision 0001 for every link that picks no time.
options.yields: WHILE a link has no expiry time THE system SHALL keep it valid until it is revoked or its note is deleted

options.answer: Replace it: every link gets a default time
options.yields: WHEN a link is created with no time THE system SHALL give it a default expiry time

options.answer: Keep the decision and drop the change
options.yields: THE system SHALL keep every shared link valid until it is revoked

body.question: What happens to the links that already exist?

options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL treat it as having no expiry time

options.answer: They get a default time from today
options.rationale: Gives old links an end date.
options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL expire it a default time from today

options.answer: They get a default time from their creation
options.rationale: Many old links would end at once.
options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL expire it a default time from its creation

body.question: What does someone see when they open an expired link?

options.answer: A page that says the link expired
options.rationale: Matches how revoked links behave today.
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a link after its expiry time THE system SHALL show that the link has expired and SHALL NOT return the note

options.answer: The same not-found answer as an unknown link
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a link after its expiry time THE system SHALL answer as for an unknown link
